Any tuition credit beyond the $5,000 transfer limit remains with the student and can be **carried forward to future years** [3]. Payments made by parents for tuition are considered gifts to the student, and the student must meet eligibility requirements to transfer credits [5].

The process involves the student completing a transfer section on the tax certificate and providing it to the parent, who then claims the credit on their tax return [4].
